issue.title: Not blindly cast to jlong when return a pointer to make it work on 32bit

repository.name: netty-tcnative
repository.description: A fork of Apache Tomcat Native, based on finagle-native

issue.body:
Motivation:

We blindly cast to jlong in one case when return a pointer and so it will not build on 32bit. Related to https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/4694.

Modifications:

Just return 0 on error and not try to cast to jlong.

Result:

Also builds on 32bit.
